messages:
Maya Patel: Quick weekly check-in for Nebula Labs — token usage + throughput snapshot. Tokens this week: 72.3M (-12% WoW, +8% QoQ). Avg throughput 220 rps, peak 450 rps. Note: p95 latency jumped to ~420ms on Tue after a model pin change. 5xx rate up from 0.05% to 0.12%.
Priya Kaur: Got it. Are they on hosted or dedicated?
Maya Patel: Hosted (paid tier). They currently pin gpt-redwood-1.3b-quant and bert-lite-v2. We applied a model pin change Tue ~13:40 UTC.
Sam Reynolds: I saw the canary deploy in the runtime logs — possible KV-cache invalidation + batching behavior change. Investigating now.
Jorge Alvarez: Dashboard snapshot here for quick reference: https://console.redwood.io/d/nebula-labs/throughput?from=2026-03-11&to=2026-03-18 (includes token/time series, p95, error breakdown).
Elena Ortiz: Renewal is in ~6 weeks. If latency persists or spend increases we should flag risk to AE. Recommend an enablement session for their infra/dev team.
Maya Patel: Action list: 1) @Sam to validate kernel selection / kv-cache regressions; 2) @Priya to schedule enablement + send proactive note to Nebula; 3) I will update CSM deck with QoQ numbers and renewal risk. Also consider quick fallback to previous model if we can't stabilize. :thumbsup:
Sam Reynolds: Quick log excerpt I pulled: ```[runtime] kernel_select: model=gpt-redwood-1.3b-quant kernel=opt_v2 seq_len=2048 batch=1 time_ms=5.2 fallback=False
[kvcache] miss_rate=0.27 baseline=0.05
[batcher] inflight=12 avg_batch=1.8``` Looks like miss rate spiked after cold start of canary.
OpsBot: Deploy bot: canary rollout gpt-redwood-1.3b-quant -> completed 2026-03-18T13:58Z :white_check_mark:
Priya Kaur: I'll reach out to Elena to prep renewal talking points and propose Wed/Tue enablement. @Elena Ortiz — can you confirm Tue availability?
Elena Ortiz: Tue works for me. Also suggest we offer a short burst-capacity add-on to smooth peaks; they hit sustained bursts during nightly processing windows.
Maya Patel: Perfect. If Sam can confirm whether cache warmup or kernel fallback is the main culprit we can decide fallback vs. patch. I'll include spend delta in the deck; current weekly spend ~ $18.2k (est). Next sync Thu EOD unless something urgent pops up.
Priya Kaur: Noted — will draft outreach and include the dashboard link and a short RCA note.
Sam Reynolds: I'll post findings by EOD and add trace links. If we need rolling rollback I'll queue it.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Closing loop after Sam posts logs.
